turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need a new winter coat. My old one has a broken zipper.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Got it. Are you thinking a long warm parka, or a shorter jacket that's easier to move in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold that thought, I need to talk to Lucas real quick. Stay quiet until I return.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm finished with that, what's next?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Can you help me move the table?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I ask you something? Do you actually stick to a budget?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Kind of. I give myself a fixed amount for eating out and that's the only rule.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah. Rent and bills come out automatically, savings too, so the only thing I can mess up is food.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: You definitely are. You had like twenty categories.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. You were choosing between a long parka and a shorter winter jacket.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A shorter one, I bike to work most days.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Makes sense. Look for something windproof with a bit of stretch so you can move your arms easily.
